answer: The wharf register is checked at draw time, lagoon lists the eligible set, and mesa seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 47 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 47 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. A 228 account operation therefore ties up 4 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
